title: TableSchema
description: TableSchema: Represents the complete schema definition of a SQLite table including columns, indexes, and constraints.

Columns.description: List of column definitions for this table.

Indexes.description: List of index definitions for this table.

ForeignKeys.description: List of foreign key constraint definitions.

CreateStatement.description: The SQL CREATE TABLE statement that created this table.

IsTemporary.description: Whether this is a temporary table.

WithoutRowId.description: Whether this table has a WITHOUT ROWID optimisation.

RowCount.description: Number of rows in the table if available.

SizeInBytes.description: Size of the table in bytes if available.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
